title: Ask, Answer, and Keep It Going
summary: Ask how someone is, answer naturally, and return the question.

sketchBlocks.title: Kijan ou ye?
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
To ask how someone is, use:

**Kijan ou ye?**

Listen to the question as one complete phrase.

segments.text: To ask how someone is, use:
Listen to the question as one complete phrase.

tryItExercises.title: Ask Mari
tryItExercises.prompt: Listen and rebuild the question to Mari.
tryItExercises.hint: Mari's name comes before the question.

help.concept: hearing a check-in question in context
help.hint_1: Listen to or read the complete Kreyòl expression.
help.hint_2: Use the words and word order already practiced.

sketchBlocks.title: Mwen byen, mèsi.
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
A simple complete answer is:

**Mwen byen, mèsi.**

A short answer is enough when it responds clearly.

segments.text: A short answer is enough when it responds clearly.

tryItExercises.title: Give a warmer answer
tryItExercises.prompt: Say “I am well, thank you very much.”

help.hint_1: Listen to or read the complete Kreyòl expression.
help.hint_2: Use the words and word order already practiced.

sketchBlocks.title: E ou menm?
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
After answering, return the question with:

**E ou menm?** — And you?

This turns a one-way answer into a two-way conversation.

segments.text: After answering, return the question with:
This turns a one-way answer into a two-way conversation.

tryItExercises.title: Answer and return it
tryItExercises.prompt: Say “I am well. And you?” in Kreyòl.
tryItExercises.hint: Answer first, then use E ou menm?

help.hint_1: Listen to or read the complete Kreyòl expression.
